scope: Executed full-stage settings for the 120 published workload/model/reasoning cells. This file describes the existing measurements; it does not prescribe new runs.

evidence_status.cell_request_fields: Recorded per attempt and checked for consistency within each cell.
evidence_status.population_counts: Recomputed from retained attempt records and matched to the executed full-stage plan.
evidence_status.per_suite_concurrency: Recorded in execution metadata and implemented as one serial lane per model.
evidence_status.cross_suite_overlap: Derived from recorded wall-clock attempt intervals among the included full-stage runs only; not a global process or account concurrency measurement.
evidence_status.client_geographic_location: Not recorded in the retained run metadata.
evidence_status.cache_state: Provider cache usage was recorded; initial cache state and cross-run cache isolation were not controlled or recorded.

latency_definition.e2e: Harness-observed duration of the final retained attempt for each planned observation, including terminal failures and locally rejected file inputs. It is not total application/document-pipeline latency.
latency_definition.ttft: Time from attempt start to the first nonempty streamed output-text delta, for final attempts where that event was observed. Failures or responses with no text delta do not contribute a TTFT sample.
latency_definition.retries: Latency percentiles use the final attempt only. Earlier attempts and the two-second retry backoff are excluded. Token totals and metered spend include every retained attempt with reported usage; missing-usage cost bounds are reported separately.
latency_definition.non_api_work: Dataset loading, authentication refresh between observations, and grading are outside successful API timing. ExtractBench PDF loading precedes its successful API timer. Some request construction occurs after the timer starts.
latency_definition.timing_source: Client monotonic timer for durations; recorded UTC timestamps for cross-suite overlap.

original_comparison.description: The four workload-suite processes overlapped. Four positive-duration recorded attempt intervals overlapped for each model across those suites.

low_and_high.description: The included low/high full-stage suite intervals did not overlap for a given model.

concurrency.interpretation: Concurrency differs between the original comparison and the low/high sensitivity runs. The reported overlap does not prove a configured global limit or describe unrelated traffic. Intervals rounded to zero duration were excluded from the overlap calculation.

cache_and_warmup.direct_openai: Automatic caching; no explicit cache key/options in these requests.
cache_and_warmup.bedrock: Implicit default caching; no explicit cache key/options in these requests.
cache_and_warmup.warmup: Parity, smoke and pilot stages preceded full evaluation. No dedicated cache warming, cache flush, cold-cache guarantee, or cross-run cache-isolation procedure is recorded.
cache_and_warmup.cost: Costs use recorded cache-read/write token attribution; no assumed cache hit is substituted for measured usage.

endpoint_and_client_location.openai: Direct Responses API; request region is unspecified (null). This does not establish client or physical processing location.
endpoint_and_client_location.client: Client geographic location, host placement and network route were not recorded. Endpoint region must not be read as client region.

runner_policy.evidence_status: Implemented by the retained runner, distinct from observed outcomes.
runner_policy.model_sampling_seed: No model sampling seed was supplied; the execution-order seed is separate.
runner_policy.temperature_and_top_p: Not explicitly supplied by the runner. Provider defaults are not measured here.
runner_policy.failure_policy: Classified retryable operational errors could receive one retry. Declared terminal file/output-limit failures remain in quality denominators. In high ExtractBench, one retry was also allowed for a classified missing-usage response.
